notes: Added a smart dialog and quote system, adapted to each language. Fixed several snapshot issues and missing translations in compare. Fixed an issue where text effects were not preserved after switching tabs. Additional minor performance improvements.

release_notes.en:
Added a smart dialog and quote system, adapted to each language
Fixed several snapshot issues and missing translations in compare
Fixed an issue where text effects were not preserved after switching tabs
Additional minor performance improvements

Pequeñas mejoras adicionales de rendimiento
